gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2121 experienced an overall deterioration of GBP 4.1 million in prior years' provisions during 2018. This was driven by deteriorations in third party liability, marine, aviation and transport, and fire and other damage to property, partially offset by improvements in energy and reinsurance acceptances. Specific events impacting prior years included 2018 losses from California wildfires, Hawaiian volcanic eruptions, Hurricanes Michael and Florence affecting the 2017 year of account, and a fire at the Lurssen shipyard impacting the 2016 and prior years. Additionally, non-catastrophe losses such as the Maersk Honam fire, Oakland property fire, and main market casualty consortium losses also affected the 2017 year of account. Reserves for 2015 and prior years showed a satisfactory development, generating a GBP 0.7 million surplus.

gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a small adverse movement on prior years with an overall deterioration of GBP 4.1m (1.3% of opening gross claims reserves), driven by adverse development mainly in third party liability (GBP 2.0m), marine (GBP 2.8m) and property/fire (GBP 3.4m), partially offset by releases in energy (GBP 2.2m) and reinsurance acceptances (GBP 1.8m). The movement reflects large-loss and adverse claims development across these classes, while favourable developments and reinsurance recoveries reduced the net deterioration.

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure taken from the Note 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' (explicitly states an overall deterioration of GBP 4.1m). The note is treated as showing gross movements (insurance liabilities) per the report's note heading. Some narrative figures elsewhere cite 'net' movements or year-of-account profits/losses; those were not used. Named event net loss references are often given in USD in the text (e.g. estimated US$44m net from six losses) and have not been converted; where only net US$ figures are referenced they are recorded in descriptions, not as quantified GBP gross impacts. If a reader requires strictly gross movement by underwriting-year triangle cross-check, the claims development table is available in the report but the movement note was used as the authoritative source.
